item.title: [IGNITE-2041] CacheAutoStoreExample: Failed to find class with given class loader for unmarshalling
item.description:

1. Start
examples/src/main/java/org/apache/ignite/examples/datagrid/store/auto/DbH2ServerStartup.java
2. Start 1 node from IDEA and 1 from terminal (with examples/config/example-ignite.xml)
3. Run CacheAutoStoreExample
